pages.main_query: how much do education assistants get paid in wa
requests: The FAQ 'What do casual Education Assistants get paid in WA?' (line 547) gives the 25% loading but no dollar figure. A computed casual rate (for example level 1.1 hourly × 1.25 from WA_RATES) would answer the query directly. It cannot be typed in this pass.

hoursNote (line 577) says 'a version with a 16% loading, the same spread over 52 weeks, and casual rates'. This is ambiguous: it could mean two or three other rate sheets. The owner should confirm which sheets the department publishes so the sentence can be made exact.

The hub lede (school-support-pay.tsx line 175) types eight entry figures by hand ($38.33, $36.28, $34.75, $31.69, $51,622, $58,360, $59,725, $58,817). They match SCHOOL_SUPPORT_STATES[].entry today, but they should be built from that data so they cannot drift when rates change.
